```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)
library(flextable)
library(NHSRplotthedots)
library(ggpubr)
library(forcats)
library(zoo)
library(scales)
library(officer)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

set_flextable_defaults(
  font.family = "Arial", font.size = 8.5,
  border.color = "gray", big.mark = "")
border <- fp_border_default()
group_border <- fp_border(color = "gray30", width = 1.5)

# Get configuration for this tumour type
# Use a different variable name to avoid shadowing the global tumour_config list
current_config <- get_tumour_config(params$tumour_key)

# Set up convenience flags for conditional chunk execution
has_fds_detailed <- !is.null(current_config$cwt_fds_detailed)
has_tv <- !is.null(current_config$treatment_variation)
has_staging_completeness <- !is.null(current_config$staging_completeness)
has_staging_demographics <- !is.null(current_config$staging_demographics)
uses_subtype_staging <- has_split(current_config, "staging_demographics")
uses_subtype_staging_completeness <- has_split(current_config, "staging_completeness")
has_public_benchmarking <- isTRUE(current_config$cwt_public_data_exists_for_benchmarking)

# Benchmarking is gated per standard: the tumour must have a public
# benchmarking bucket AND not have opted out of that standard in tumours.yml
# (display_benchmarking_fds / _31day / _62day). FDS-only pathways such as
# non-specific symptoms opt out of 31-day and 62-day.
has_benchmarking_fds <- has_public_benchmarking && includes_benchmarking(current_config, "fds")
has_benchmarking_31 <- has_public_benchmarking && includes_benchmarking(current_config, "31day")
has_benchmarking_62 <- has_public_benchmarking && includes_benchmarking(current_config, "62day")

# A split benchmarking standard (e.g. Urology's 31-day/62-day — see the null /
# scalar / array convention in config/tumours.yml's header) comes back from
# process_benchmarking() as a named list of tables instead of one table; a
# plain data.frame is never itself a list of data.frames, so this check is
# reliable without consulting the config again.
is_split_benchmark <- function(x) is.list(x) && !is.data.frame(x)

# Data-presence gates for sections that have no config flag. A tumour with no
# rows in a source extract gets NULL from validate_df_not_empty_warn(), so the
# absence of data is the signal — no configuration needed. FDS-only pathways
# such as non-specific symptoms have no 62-day or LWBC data at all.
has_62_totals <- !is.null(tumour_data$day_62$plot$total_treated)
has_62_summary <- !is.null(tumour_data$day_62$raw$comm) ||
  !is.null(tumour_data$day_62$summary$provider)
uses_subtype_lwbc <- has_split(current_config, "lwbc")
has_lwbc_table <- !is.null(tumour_data$lwbc$table)
has_lwbc_plot <- !is.null(tumour_data$lwbc$plot)
has_lwbc_pa_plot <- !is.null(tumour_data$lwbc$pa_plot)
has_lwbc_trust_plot <- !is.null(tumour_data$lwbc$trust_plot)
has_lwbc_trust_pa_plot <- !is.null(tumour_data$lwbc$trust_pa_plot)
has_lwbc <- !is.null(current_config$lwbc)
has_cwt_31_spc <- !is.null(tumour_data$day_31$plot)
has_cwt_62_spc <- !is.null(tumour_data$day_62$plot)

# Get treatment variation target if applicable
if (has_tv && !is.null(current_config$treatment_variation_target_name)) {
  tv_target <- get(current_config$treatment_variation_target_name)
}

# tumour_data is pre-loaded by main.R using read_tumour_data(tumour_key, global_data)

```

# Cancer Waiting Times

## FDS Summary

```{r fds_summary, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# The rule-in/rule-out bullets are gated on has_fds_detailed: Rule-in/Rule-out
# and the FDS Pathway End Reason breakdown only exist when a detailed-extract
# category is set for this tumour (cwt_fds_detailed) — a tumour sourced
# entirely from the public extract (cwt_fds_detailed: null, e.g. a tumour the
# detailed extract has no distinct bucket for) has no Pathway End Reason
# breakdown to show, so this content, and nothing else, is skipped for it.
cat(paste0(
  "- The **", tumour_data$fds$raw$provider_comm$Period,
  "** 28-day Faster Diagnosis Standard (FDS) was **",
  tumour_data$fds$raw$provider_comm$Compliance,
  "%** compared to the national target of ", CWT_STANDARD_FDS_PC, "%.\n"
))
cat(paste0(
  "    + This was equivalent to ",
  sqrt((tumour_data$fds$raw$provider_comm[["Diff from std"]])^2), " patients ",
  if_else(tumour_data$fds$raw$provider_comm[["Diff from std"]] < 0, "below", "above"),
  " the target.\n\n"
))

above <- tumour_data$counts$fds_trusts_above
below <- tumour_data$counts$fds_trusts_below
cat(paste0(
  "- In **", format(tumour_data$fds$summary$provider$PERIOD, "%B %Y"), "** ",
  if_else(above == 1, paste0("there was ", above, " Trust"), paste0("there were ", above, " Trusts")),
  " in the ", alliance_name, " meeting the FDS target of ", CWT_STANDARD_FDS_PC, "%, with ",
  if_else(below == 1, paste0(below, " Trust"), paste0(below, " Trusts")),
  " not meeting the target, based on submitted data.\n\n"
))

if (has_fds_detailed) {
  cat(paste0(
    "- The **", format(tumour_data$fds$rule_in_comm$summary$Date, "%B %Y"),
    "** FDS for **Pathway End Reason - diagnosis of cancer** was **",
    tumour_data$fds$rule_in_comm$summary$COMPLIANCE,
    "%** compared to the national target of ", CWT_STANDARD_FDS_PC, "%.\n"
  ))
  cat(paste0(
    "    + This was equivalent to ",
    sqrt((tumour_data$fds$rule_in_comm$summary$Patients_Above_FDS_Target)^2), " patients ",
    if_else(tumour_data$fds$rule_in_comm$summary$Patients_Above_FDS_Target < 0, "below", "above"),
    " the target.\n\n"
  ))

  ri_above <- tumour_data$counts$fds_ri_trusts_above
  ri_below <- tumour_data$counts$fds_ri_trusts_below
  cat(paste0(
    "- In **", format(tumour_data$fds$rule_in$summary$Date, "%B %Y"), "** for **Diagnosis of Cancer**, ",
    if_else(ri_above == 1, paste0("there was ", ri_above, " Trust"), paste0("there were ", ri_above, " Trusts")),
    " in the ", alliance_name, " meeting the FDS target of ", CWT_STANDARD_FDS_PC, "%, with ",
    if_else(ri_below == 1, paste0(ri_below, " Trust"), paste0(ri_below, " Trusts")),
    " not meeting the target, based on submitted data.\n\n"
  ))
}
```

```{r 62_day_summary, eval=has_62_summary, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# Gated on has_62_summary: with no 62-day data every inline value below
# resolves to NULL, which prints as an empty string rather than erroring, so
# an ungated version of this slide renders authoritative-looking prose full of
# blanks and "NA". Wording is unchanged from the previous inline-markdown
# version; only the gating and the cat() wrapper are new.
comm <- tumour_data$day_62$raw$comm

compliance_text <- if (is.null(comm)) {
  paste('NA')
} else if (nrow(comm) > 1) {
  paste0(comm$Compliance[1], "% for ", comm$"Cancer Type"[1], ", and ",
         comm$Compliance[2], "% for ", comm$"Cancer Type"[2])
} else {
  paste0(comm$Compliance, "% ")
}

diff_text <- if (is.null(comm)) {
  paste('NA')
} else if (nrow(comm) > 1) {
  paste0(sqrt((comm$"Diff from std"[1])^2), " patients ",
         if_else(comm$"Diff from std"[1] < 0, paste("below"), paste("above")),
         " and ", sqrt((comm$"Diff from std"[2])^2), " patients ",
         if_else(comm$"Diff from std"[2] < 0,
                 paste("below the target respectively"),
                 paste("above the target respectively")))
} else if (nrow(comm) == 1) {
  paste0(sqrt((comm$"Diff from std")^2), " patients ",
         if_else(comm$"Diff from std" < 0,
                 paste("below the target"), paste("above the target")))
}

above <- tumour_data$counts$day_62_trusts_above
below <- tumour_data$counts$day_62_trusts_below

cat("\n\n## 62-Day Summary\n\n")

cat(paste0(
  "- The **", comm$Period[1], "** 62-day referral to treatment waiting time ",
  "standard was **", compliance_text, "** compared to the national target of ",
  CWT_STANDARD_62DAY_PC, "%.\n"
))

cat(paste0(
  "    + This was equivalent to ", diff_text, ".\n\n"
))

cat(paste0(
  "- In **", format(tumour_data$day_62$summary$provider$PERIOD, "%B %Y"), "** ",
  if_else(above == 1, paste0("there was ", above, " Trust"),
          paste0("there were ", above, " Trusts")),
  " in the ", alliance_name, " meeting the 62-day target of ",
  CWT_STANDARD_62DAY_PC, "%, with ",
  if_else(below == 1, paste0(below, " Trust"), paste0(below, " Trusts")),
  " not meeting the target, based on submitted data.\n\n"
))
```

## CWT Compliance - `r as.yearmon(latest_month, "%Y %m")`

```{r cwt_standards_table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# The column layout varies by tumour. create_standards_table() joins only the
# standards a tumour actually has, so the usual 7 columns (ORG.NAME plus a
# compliance/patients pair per standard) drop to 3 for an FDS-only pathway such
# as non-specific symptoms. Select columns by name rather than by position:
# hardcoded j = c(3,5,7) would either land on the wrong columns or index past
# the end, and naming an absent column in highlight() is an error.
tbl_names <- names(tumour_data$standards_table)
compliance_cols <- grep("Compliance \\(%\\)$", tbl_names, value = TRUE)
patients_cols <- grep("^No\\. patients above", tbl_names, value = TRUE)

standards_tbl <- flextable(tumour_data$standards_table) %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  width(j = 1, width = 4)

if (length(patients_cols) > 0) {
  standards_tbl <- width(standards_tbl, j = patients_cols, width = 1.4)
}
if (length(compliance_cols) > 0) {
  standards_tbl <- width(standards_tbl, j = compliance_cols, width = 1)
}

standards_tbl <- add_footer_lines(standards_tbl, SLIDE_FOOTER_CWT_TABLE)

group_rows <- get_provider_group_boundaries(tumour_data$standards_table, tumour_data$config, code_col = "ORG.NAME")
for (r in group_rows) {
  standards_tbl <- hline(standards_tbl, i = r, border = group_border)
}

# Highlight below-target compliance cells, for whichever standards are present.
# The formula is built as a string because the column name varies; the
# threshold is interpolated as a literal so it does not depend on the
# evaluation environment flextable uses for the formula.
highlight_specs <- list(
  list(col = "Latest FDS Compliance (%)", threshold = CWT_STANDARD_FDS_PC),
  list(col = "Latest 31-Day Compliance (%)", threshold = CWT_STANDARD_31DAY_PC),
  list(col = "Latest 62-Day Compliance (%)", threshold = CWT_STANDARD_62DAY_PC)
)

for (spec in highlight_specs) {
  if (!spec$col %in% tbl_names) next

  standards_tbl <- flextable::highlight(
    standards_tbl,
    i = as.formula(paste0("~ `", spec$col, "` < ", spec$threshold)),
    j = spec$col,
    color = "yellow"
  )
}

standards_tbl
```

```{r cwt_28_day_benchmarking_table, eval=has_benchmarking_fds, results='asis', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Builds the finished flextable for one FDS benchmarking table (`dat` is one
# raw table from process_benchmark_standard()). Factored out so a split
# standard (see is_split_benchmark() in the setup chunk) can call it once per
# group instead of duplicating this block.
build_fds_benchmarking_table <- function(dat) {
  national_provider_count <- attr(dat, "national_provider_count")

  table_data <- dat %>%
    select(-ORG.CODE) %>%
    rename(Provider = ORG.NAME) %>%
    mutate(Provider = case_when(
      Provider == "National Average" ~ "[National Average]",
      Provider == "Alliance Average" ~ sprintf("[%s]", alliance),
      TRUE ~ Provider
    )) %>%
    mutate(`Latest FDS Compliance` = paste0(round(`Latest FDS Compliance (%)`, 1), " %")) %>%
    relocate(`Latest FDS Compliance`, .before = `Latest FDS Compliance (%)`) %>%
    mutate(`Difference from the target (no. patients)` = if_else(
      Provider == "[National Average]",
      "",
      get_pt_diff_friendly(`Difference from the target (no. patients)`)
    )) %>%
    rename(!!sprintf("National FDS Ranking\n(of %d)", national_provider_count) := `National FDS Ranking`)

  ft <- flextable(table_data) |>
    bold(part = "header") |>
    width(j = 1, width = 4) |>
    width(j = c(2,3,4,5), width = 1.4) |>
    align(j = setdiff(names(table_data), "Provider"), align = "right", part = "body") |>
    align(j = setdiff(names(table_data), "Provider"), align = "center", part = "header") |>
    align(j = grep("National Ranking|Ranking difference from previous month", names(table_data), value = TRUE), align = "center", part = "body")

  group_rows <- get_provider_group_boundaries(table_data, tumour_data$config, code_col = "Provider", offset = 2)
  for (r in group_rows) {
    ft <- hline(ft, i = r, border = group_border)
  }

  ft <- flextable::highlight(ft, i = ~ `Latest FDS Compliance (%)` < CWT_STANDARD_FDS_PC, j = "Latest FDS Compliance", color = "yellow")
  ft <- delete_columns(ft, j = "Latest FDS Compliance (%)") |>
    add_footer_lines(SLIDE_FOOTER_CWT_BENCHMARKING_TABLE)
  ft
}

# A split standard gets one "##" heading (= one slide) per group, matching
# the split staging/LWBC sections; "###" would stack every group's table on
# one slide.
if (is_split_benchmark(tumour_data$benchmarking$day_28)) {
  for (grp in names(tumour_data$benchmarking$day_28)) {
    cat("\n\n## FDS - Benchmarking -", grp, "\n\n")
    flextable::flextable_to_rmd(build_fds_benchmarking_table(tumour_data$benchmarking$day_28[[grp]]))
  }
} else {
  cat("\n\n## FDS - Benchmarking\n\n")
  flextable::flextable_to_rmd(build_fds_benchmarking_table(tumour_data$benchmarking$day_28))
}
```

```{r cwt_31_day_benchmarking_table, eval=has_benchmarking_31, results='asis', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# See build_fds_benchmarking_table() above for why this is factored out.
build_31day_benchmarking_table <- function(dat) {
  national_provider_count <- attr(dat, "national_provider_count")

  table_data <- dat %>%
    select(-ORG.CODE) %>%
    rename(Provider = ORG.NAME) %>%
    mutate(Provider = case_when(
      Provider == "National Average" ~ "[National Average]",
      Provider == "Alliance Average" ~ sprintf("[%s]", alliance),
      TRUE ~ Provider
    )) %>%
    mutate(`Latest 31 Day Compliance` = paste0(round(`Latest FDS Compliance (%)`, 1), " %")) %>%
    relocate(`Latest 31 Day Compliance`, .before = `Latest FDS Compliance (%)`) %>%
    rename(!!sprintf("Latest 31 Day National Ranking\n(of %d)", national_provider_count) := `National FDS Ranking`) %>%
    mutate(`Difference from the target (no. patients)` = if_else(
      Provider == "[National Average]",
      "",
      get_pt_diff_friendly(`Difference from the target (no. patients)`)
    ))

  ft <- flextable(table_data) |>
    bold(part = "header") |>
    width(j = 1, width = 4) |>
    width(j = c(2,3,4,5), width = 1.4) |>
    align(j = setdiff(names(table_data), "Provider"), align = "right", part = "body") |>
    align(j = setdiff(names(table_data), "Provider"), align = "center", part = "header") |>
    align(j = grep("National Ranking|Ranking difference from previous month", names(table_data), value = TRUE), align = "center", part = "body")

  group_rows <- get_provider_group_boundaries(table_data, tumour_data$config, code_col = "Provider", offset = 2)
  for (r in group_rows) {
    ft <- hline(ft, i = r, border = group_border)
  }

  ft <- flextable::highlight(ft, i = ~ `Latest FDS Compliance (%)` < CWT_STANDARD_31DAY_PC, j = "Latest 31 Day Compliance", color = "yellow")
  ft <- delete_columns(ft, j = "Latest FDS Compliance (%)") |>
    add_footer_lines(SLIDE_FOOTER_CWT_BENCHMARKING_TABLE)
  ft
}

# A split standard gets one "##" heading (= one slide) per group, matching
# the split staging/LWBC sections; "###" would stack every group's table on
# one slide.
if (is_split_benchmark(tumour_data$benchmarking$day_31)) {
  for (grp in names(tumour_data$benchmarking$day_31)) {
    cat("\n\n## 31-Day - Benchmarking -", grp, "\n\n")
    flextable::flextable_to_rmd(build_31day_benchmarking_table(tumour_data$benchmarking$day_31[[grp]]))
  }
} else {
  cat("\n\n## 31-Day - Benchmarking\n\n")
  flextable::flextable_to_rmd(build_31day_benchmarking_table(tumour_data$benchmarking$day_31))
}
```

```{r Treatment_Variation_tumour, eval=has_tv, fig.width=20, fig.height=8, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tbl <- tumour_data$treatment_variation$tumour$tumour_numeric_table

avg_cols   <- grep("Moving avg \\(%\\)$", names(tbl))
cases_cols <- grep("Case volume$", names(tbl))
cases_cols_between <- cases_cols[cases_cols < ncol(tbl)]

ft <- flextable(tbl) |>
  colformat_double( j = cases_cols, na_str = "-" ) |>
  separate_header(split = "_") |>
  bold(part = "header") |>
  add_header_lines(values = paste("Indicator:", tumour_data$treatment_variation$tumour$indicator_text)) |>
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
  padding(
    part = "all",
    padding.top = 1, padding.bottom = 1,
    padding.left = 2, padding.right = 2
  ) |>
  padding(j = avg_cols,   padding.right = 0, part = "all") |>
  padding(j = cases_cols, padding.left  = 0, part = "all") |>
  vline(j = "Trust", border = fp_border(color = "grey70", width = 0.5), part = "all") |>
  vline(j = avg_cols, border = fp_border(color = "grey70", width = 0.5), part = "all") |>
  vline(j = cases_cols_between, border = fp_border(color = "grey70", width = 1), part = "all") |>
  hline(i = 2, j = 1:ncol(tbl), border = fp_border(color = "grey70", width = 1.5), part = "header") |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all") |>
  width(j = "Trust", width = 1.5) |>
  width(j = avg_cols, width = 0.55) |>
  width(j = cases_cols, width = 0.55) |>
  add_footer_lines('"-" Represents small number suppression by NATCAN.')

ft
```

```{r stage_completeness, eval=has_staging_completeness && !uses_subtype_staging_completeness, fig.width=20, fig.height=8, dev='svglite', fig.ext='svg',echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

tumour_data$staging$completeness$figure %>%
  mutate(ORG.NAME = fct_reorder(ORG.NAME, `Stage Completeness %`),
         Patients_Above_Target = round(Patients_Above_Target)) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = `Stage Completeness %`, y = ORG.NAME)) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    aes(fill = cut(`Stage Completeness %`,
                    breaks = c(-Inf, 60, 80, Inf),
                    labels = c("Below 60%", "60% to 80%", "80% or Above"),
                    right = FALSE,
                    ordered_result = TRUE))
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = STAGING_COMPLETENESS_TARGET_PC, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 60, linetype = "dashed", color = "orange", size = 1.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Patients_Above_Target),
            hjust = -1,
            size = 3,
            color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Staging Completeness Level",
    values = c("Below 60%" = "red",
               "60% to 80%" = "grey",
               "80% or Above" = "blue"),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16)
    ) +
  xlim(0,100) +
  labs(
    x = "Staging Completeness (%)",
    y = "Trust",
    title = NULL,
    caption = paste0(SLIDE_FOOTER_STAGING_COMP_CHART, " Numbers indicate patients above the target."))
```

```{r lwbc_section_header, eval=has_lwbc, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# Whole LWBC section gated on config$lwbc being non-null. A tumour with no
# LWBC data (e.g. non-specific symptoms) sets lwbc: null and this, and
# everything below, is skipped.
cat("\n\n# Living With and Beyond Cancer\n\n")
```

```{r lwbc_subtype_q_table, eval=has_lwbc && uses_subtype_lwbc, fig.width=26, fig.height=10, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Split LWBC (see the null / scalar / array convention in config/tumours.yml's
# header): one "LWBC - Summary" slide per group, mirroring
# stage_completeness_subtype_bar above. When config$lwbc is not split, this
# whole chunk is skipped and the flat lwbc_q_table chunk below runs instead.
for (grp in names(tumour_data$lwbc)) {
  lwbc_grp <- tumour_data$lwbc[[grp]]
  if (is.null(lwbc_grp$table)) next

  cat(paste0("\n\n## LWBC - Summary ", lwbc_latest_q, " (", lwbc_latest_q_months, ") - ", grp, "\n\n"))

  most_recent_df <- lwbc_grp$table %>%
    filter(`Cancer Alliance` == alliance_name,
           Date == lwbc_latest_q) %>%
    mutate(`Total HNA's Offered` = as.character(`Total HNA's Offered`),
           `PCSP Total` = as.character(`PCSP Total`),
           `Total PA's Assessed` = as.character(`Total PA's Assessed`),
           `% HNA's Accepted` = as.character(round(`% HNA's Accepted`, 0)),
           `% PCSP's Completed` = as.character(round(`% PCSP's Completed`, 0)),
           `% PA's Achieved` = as.character(round(`% PA's Achieved`, 0)),
           `No. End of Treatment Summaries` = as.character(`No. End of Treatment Summaries`))

  most_recent_df[is.na(most_recent_df)] <- "-"

  most_recent_df <- most_recent_df %>%
    mutate(`% HNA's Accepted` = paste0(`% HNA's Accepted`, " %"),
           `% PCSP's Completed` = paste0(`% PCSP's Completed`, " %"),
            `% PA's Achieved` = paste0(`% PA's Achieved`, " %")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-c(`Cancer Alliance`, Date, `Tumour Group`)) %>%
   rename(`Total Physical Activity Assessments` = `Total PA's Assessed`,
    `% Meeting Guidance Level` = `% PA's Achieved`)

  table <- flextable(most_recent_df) %>%
    vline(j = c(1,3,5,7), border = border, part = "all") %>%
    width(j = 1, width = 2.5) %>%
    width(j = c(2,4,6), width = 1) %>%
    width(j = c(3,5,7,8), width = 1.5)

  # hline's row selection is out of range when there is only one row
  if (nrow(most_recent_df) > 1) {
    table <- hline(table, i = nrow(most_recent_df)-1, border = border)
  }

  table <- align(table, align = "center", part = "all")
  table <- fontsize(table, size = 10, part = "all")

  flextable::flextable_to_rmd(table)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r lwbc_subtype_ts, eval=has_lwbc && uses_subtype_lwbc, fig.width=26, fig.height=10, dev='svglite', fig.ext='svg', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
for (grp in names(tumour_data$lwbc)) {
  lwbc_grp <- tumour_data$lwbc[[grp]]
  if (is.null(lwbc_grp$plot)) next

  plot_data <- lwbc_grp$plot %>%
    filter(`Cancer Alliance` == alliance_name)
  # Group has rows for other alliances only: no chart, so no slide.
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) next

  cat("\n\n## LWBC - Summary Time Series -", grp, "\n\n")

  axis_scale <- lwbc_dual_axis_scale(plot_data)
  scale_factor <- axis_scale$scale_factor

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(Date)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = `% HNA's Accepted`, color = "% HNA's Accepted"), size = 1.5) +
    geom_point(aes(y = `% HNA's Accepted`, color = "% HNA's Accepted"), size = 4)  +
    geom_line(aes(y = `% PCSP's Completed`, color = "% PCSP's Completed"), size = 1.5) +
    geom_point(aes(y = `% PCSP's Completed`, color = "% PCSP's Completed"), size = 4) +
    geom_line(aes(y = `No. EOTS's Completed` / scale_factor, color = "No. EOTS's Completed"), size = 1.5) +
    geom_point(aes(y = `No. EOTS's Completed` / scale_factor, color = "No. EOTS's Completed"), size = 4) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "HNAs Accepted (%) / PCSP Completed (%)",
      limits = c(0, axis_scale$y_max),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ .* scale_factor, name = "No. EOTS's Completed")) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels =  "%b %Y")  +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 16)) +
    theme(legend.text=element_text(size=18),
          legend.position = 'bottom',
          legend.title = element_text(size = 16)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("% HNA's Accepted" = "#009E73", "% PCSP's Completed" = "#E69F00", "No. EOTS's Completed" = '#CC79A7'))

  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r lwbc_subtype_pa_ts, eval=has_lwbc && uses_subtype_lwbc, fig.width=30, fig.height=12, dev='svglite', fig.ext='svg', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
}
```

```{r lwbc_subtype_trust_ts, eval=has_lwbc && uses_subtype_lwbc, fig.width=26, fig.height=10, dev='svglite', fig.ext='svg', echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
for (grp in names(tumour_data$lwbc)) {
  lwbc_grp <- tumour_data$lwbc[[grp]]
  if (is.null(lwbc_grp$trust_plot)) next

  plot_data <- lwbc_grp$trust_plot %>%
    filter(`Cancer Alliance` == alliance_name)
  # Group has rows for other alliances only: no chart, so no slide.
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) next

  cat("\n\n## LWBC - Summary Time Series (per Trust) -", grp, "\n\n")

  axis_scale <- lwbc_dual_axis_scale(plot_data)
  scale_factor <- axis_scale$scale_factor

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(Date)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = `% HNA's Accepted`, color = "% HNA's Accepted"), size = 1.5) +
    geom_point(aes(y = `% HNA's Accepted`, color = "% HNA's Accepted"), size = 4)  +
    geom_line(aes(y = `% PCSP's Completed`, color = "% PCSP's Completed"), size = 1.5) +
    geom_point(aes(y = `% PCSP's Completed`, color = "% PCSP's Completed"), size = 4) +
    geom_line(aes(y = `No. EOTS's Completed` / scale_factor, color = "No. EOTS's Completed"), size = 1.5) +
    geom_point(aes(y = `No. EOTS's Completed` / scale_factor, color = "No. EOTS's Completed"), size = 4) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "HNAs Accepted (%) / PCSPs Completed (%)",
      limits = c(0, axis_scale$y_max),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ .* scale_factor, name = "No. EOTS's Completed")) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels =  "%b %Y")  +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 16)) +
    theme(legend.text=element_text(size=18),
          legend.position = 'bottom',
          legend.title = element_text(size = 16)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("% HNA's Accepted" = "#009E73", "% PCSP's Completed" = "#E69F00", "No. EOTS's Completed" = '#CC79A7')) +
    facet_wrap(~`Trust Name`) +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 14))

  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```


```{r lwbc_q_table, eval=has_lwbc_table, fig.width=26, fig.height=10, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

most_recent_df <- tumour_data$lwbc$table %>%
  filter(`Cancer Alliance` == alliance_name,
         Date == lwbc_latest_q) %>%
  mutate(`Total HNA's Offered` = as.character(`Total HNA's Offered`),
         `PCSP Total` = as.character(`PCSP Total`),
         `Total PA's Assessed` = as.character(`Total PA's Assessed`),
         `% HNA's Accepted` = as.character(round(`% HNA's Accepted`, 0)),
         `% PCSP's Completed` = as.character(round(`% PCSP's Completed`, 0)),
         `% PA's Achieved` = as.character(round(`% PA's Achieved`, 0)),
         `No. End of Treatment Summaries` = as.character(`No. End of Treatment Summaries`))

most_recent_df[is.na(most_recent_df)] <- "-"

most_recent_df <- most_recent_df %>%
  mutate(`% HNA's Accepted` = paste0(`% HNA's Accepted`, " %"),
         `% PCSP's Completed` = paste0(`% PCSP's Completed`, " %"),
          `% PA's Achieved` = paste0(`% PA's Achieved`, " %")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-c(`Cancer Alliance`, Date, `Tumour Group`)) %>%
 rename(`Total Physical Activity Assessments` = `Total PA's Assessed`, 
  `% Meeting Guidance Level` = `% PA's Achieved`)

table <- flextable(most_recent_df) %>%
  vline(j = c(1,3,5,7), border = border, part = "all") %>%
  width(j = 1, width = 2.5) %>%
  width(j = c(2,4,6), width = 1) %>%
  width(j = c(3,5,7,8), width = 1.5)

# hline's row selection is out of range when there is only one row
if (nrow(most_recent_df) > 1) {
  table <- hline(table, i = nrow(most_recent_df)-1, border = border)
}

table <- align(table, align = "center", part = "all")
table <- fontsize(table, size = 10, part = "all")

table
```

# Further Information

## Data Sources

The Alliance does not collect or control the data presented within this report.
It is collated from a variety of sources, the majority of which are populated
by submissions that individual providers make to national systems such as [Cancer Waiting Times](https://nwwcancerwaitingtimes.sdcs.digital.nhs.uk/) (CWT) or [Cancer Outcomes Services Dataset](https://digital.nhs.uk/ndrs/data/data-sets/cosd) (COSD).

### Cancer Waiting Times
- [NHSE Public Cancer Waiting Times Statistics](https://www.england.nhs.uk/statistics/statistical-work-areas/cancer-waiting-times/)
- NHSE Data Extract for Cancer Alliances - circulated internally to alliances via email.
- Fed by: provider submissions to [Cancer Waiting Times system](https://nwwcancerwaitingtimes.sdcs.digital.nhs.uk/).

### Staging Completeness
- [NDRS Staging Completeness Dashboard](https://digital.nhs.uk/ndrs/data/data-outputs/staging-completeness-dashboard)
- Fed by: provider submissions to [COSD](https://digital.nhs.uk/ndrs/data/data-sets/cosd).

### Staging including Early Stage Inequalities
- [NDRS Rapid Cancer Registration Dataset (RCRD) extracts for cancer alliances](https://nhs.sharepoint.com/:f:/r/sites/msteams_275dcb/Shared%20Documents/RCRD/Data_Extracts?csf=1&web=1&e=kwRI5v)
- Fed by: provider submissions to systems including [CWT](https://nwwcancerwaitingtimes.sdcs.digital.nhs.uk/), [COSD](https://digital.nhs.uk/ndrs/data/data-sets/cosd), [HES](https://digital.nhs.uk/data-and-information/data-tools-and-services/data-services/hospital-episode-statistics), [SACT](https://digital.nhs.uk/ndrs/data/data-sets/sact), and [RTDS](https://digital.nhs.uk/ndrs/data/data-sets/rtds).

### Living With and Beyond Cancer
- [NDRS Data Quality and Insights Hub](https://digital.nhs.uk/ndrs/data/data-outputs/data-quality-and-insights-hub?area=lwbc)
- Fed by provider submissions to [COSD](https://digital.nhs.uk/ndrs/data/data-sets/cosd) (v10 only).

## Resources

- See our [FutureNHS workspace](https://future.nhs.uk/MidlandsCancerAlliancesAnalytics/groupHome) for more reports, including our dashboards:
    - [Cancer Waiting Times dashboard](https://public.tableau.com/app/profile/west.midlands.cancer.alliance/viz/CWT-Dashboard/Intro)
    - [Early Diagnosis Staging dashboard](https://public.tableau.com/app/profile/west.midlands.cancer.alliance/viz/EDStagingDashboard/Home)
    
- For an exhaustive list of cancer data sources, see our ['resources' page](https://quibey.com/wmca/cancer-datasets-and-dashboards).

```{r category_mapping_table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# tumour_data$category_mapping is built in main.R (build_category_mapping_table()),
# using the same field gating as the processing functions above, so a row only
# appears here if that dataset field was actually used to build this pack.
mapping_tbl <- flextable(tumour_data$category_mapping) %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  width(j = "Tumour", width = 1.8) %>%
  width(j = "Dataset field", width = 1.3) %>%
  width(j = c("Selected value(s)", "All possible values"), width = 3.3) %>%
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") %>%
  valign(valign = "top", part = "body") %>%
  add_footer_lines(paste(
    "For each source dataset this tumour type's data is filtered from,",
    "shows every raw value the dataset contains and which value(s)",
    "config/tumours.yml selects to build this pack."
  ))

mapping_tbl
```
